game.title: Saints Row IV
game.blurb: Open-world action-adventure in which the Saints gain super powers inside a simulated Steelport, from Volition, released 2013-08-20. RAWG average playtime: 13 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Story missions from "The Saints Wing" to "Grand Finale". Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Homies and Loyalty Missions
chapters.summary: Doing everything for each crew member, and finishing the story after all Homie missions.

chapters.title: Open World, Challenges and Collectibles
chapters.summary: Clearing districts of the simulated Steelport, Challenges, Audio Logs, Data Clusters and long jumps.

chapters.title: Super Powers and Weapons
chapters.summary: Super Powers, elements and upgrades, alien kills and weapon upgrades and styles.

chapters.title: Co-op and Online
chapters.summary: Co-op time, quests and missions together, and sharing a character online.

chapters.title: Enter the Dominatrix (DLC, likely)
chapters.summary: A block of achievements for missions such as "Meet the Dominatrix", "At the Races" and "Escape the Dominatrix".

chapters.title: Five-Mission Add-on with Raptors
chapters.summary: A block of five missions, raptors, and heavy-weapon kill counts. The add-on name is not in the data.

chapters.title: Holiday Missions
chapters.summary: Christmas-themed missions at the North Pole, Santa letters, snowmen and holiday activities.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 206420)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Saints_Row_IV
Fandom (saintsrow.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://saintsrow.fandom.com/wiki/Saints_Row_IV
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0, tagged Stubs); it links Gameplay, Table of Contents and Walkthrough subpages but none of them exist (a prefix search found no subpages). saintsrow.fandom.com answers the API, with about 143 linked pages, including "Saints Row IV: Enter the Dominatrix", "How the Saints Save Christmas" and many DLC pack pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam app list names app 206420 "Saints Row IV: Re-Elected"; its schema gives only the placeholder name "ValveTestApp206420". 8 of 73 Steam achievements are hidden; 3 (Zero Saints Thirty, Bouncin' with an Old Friend, You Chose... Poorly) sit in the main story chapter as a placeholder, and the rest were placed in the DLC blocks by schema position. The Dominatrix chapter is inferred from mission names in achievement text plus the Fandom page name; "All Too Easy" (Zinyak in 'Save the Planet') was put there by schema position and may belong to the base game. Achievements 59 to 63 form a five-mission block with raptors whose add-on name is not in the data. The holiday chapter is probably the Fandom page "How the Saints Save Christmas", but the achievements do not name it.
